description: This file implements the RefRadioConfig class, specifically the getSimultaneousCallingSupport method, which responds with radio support information. It includes external headers for radio configuration and service, and defines functions related to radio response handling within the cf::ril namespace.

classes.name: RefRadioConfig
classes.description: A class providing radio configuration responses, including support for querying simultaneous calling support.

methods.name: getSimultaneousCallingSupport
methods.description: Handles the request to determine if simultaneous calling is supported, responding with the appropriate radio response.
